# Add tiny+full spec demo fuzzing

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary

Runs the fuzz demo against every team in **both** `tiny` and `full` JAM specs, with explicit per-spec badges, and converts the long-running fuzz to a `[tiny, full]` matrix for typeberry and turbojam.

- Plumbs `JAM_FUZZ_SPEC` end-to-end: env-derived in the test harness (`tests/common.ts`), wired through both reusable workflows (`demo-source.yml`, `graymatter-fuzz-source.yml`), and exposed as a workflow input that also appends \`--spec=<value>\` to the graymatter source command.
- 23 × 2 new per-team demo workflow files (`<team>-demo-tiny.yml` / `<team>-demo-full.yml`) — separate files give each spec its own GHA badge. Full-spec runs are env-only by policy: `docker_cmd` is omitted so targets must read `JAM_FUZZ_SOCK_PATH`.
- typeberry/turbojam `<team>-fuzz.yml` are now matrix workflows over `[tiny, full]` on a single badge. turbojam `num_blocks` halved 350 000 → 175 000 so the two serialized matrix entries fit the original 23 h envelope. The demo: job is removed from both (now lives in the demo-tiny/demo-full files).
- 21 obsolete `<team>-fuzz.yml` files (demo-only teams) deleted — coverage moved to the per-spec demo files.
- README restructured: Status table now has \`Performance | Demo (tiny) | Demo (full) | Long-run\`; Adding-your-team section gets two demo workflow templates and explains the env-only contract for full; Project structure block updated.

## Expected day-one signal

Most teams' \`demo-full\` workflow may fail on the first scheduled run (target images that don't yet support \`full\`). That's the intended signal — required-for-everyone was the agreed approach.

## Test plan

- [ ] \`workflow_dispatch\` typeberry-demo-tiny.yml on this branch — should pass.
- [ ] \`workflow_dispatch\` typeberry-demo-full.yml on this branch — should pass if typeberry supports full; otherwise reveals the gap.
- [ ] Render-check the README on the PR's "Files changed" view (table renders with 5 columns × 23 rows; badges all resolve).
- [ ] Spot-check that one new \`fuzz-failure\` issue gets the \`tiny\` or \`full\` label (not deduped against the other spec).

## Comment by @coderabbitai[bot]

_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_

<details>
<summary>🧩 Analysis chain</summary>

🌐 Web query:

`In GitHub Actions expressions, does `condition && '' || 'fallback'` resolve to `'fallback'` because empty string is falsy?`

💡 Result:

Yes, `condition && '' || 'fallback'` resolves to `'fallback'` in GitHub Actions expressions because the empty string `''` is explicitly listed as a falsy value that gets coerced to `false` in conditionals and logical operations [1][2][3][4]. The `&&` operator short-circuits and evaluates to the second operand (`''`) if the first (`condition`) is truthy, but since `''` is falsy, the `||` then evaluates its right side (`'fallback'`) [5][6]. This behavior is a common gotcha with the `&& ||` idiom used as a ternary workaround, where the "true" branch must be truthy (non-empty/non-falsy) to avoid falling through to the fallback [7][5][8]. Official docs confirm falsy values include `""`, `' '`, `null`, `0`, etc., for `&&` and `||` [1].

Citations:

- 1: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/evaluate-expressions-in-workflows-and-actions
- 2: https://docs.github.com/actions/reference/evaluate-expressions-in-workflows-and-actions
- 3: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/expressions
- 4: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-what-your-workflow-does/evaluate-expressions-in-workflows-and-actions
- 5: https://github.com/actions/runner/issues/409?timeline_page=1
- 6: https://github.com/actions/runner/issues/409
- 7: https://docs.github.com/ru/enterprise-server@3.5/actions/learn-github-actions/expressions
- 8: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79541731/what-is-the-ternary-operator-equivalent-in-github-actions

---



</details>

**`docker_cmd` conditional won't be empty for `spec: full`.**

Using `matrix.spec == 'full' && '' || ...` falls through to the fallback because the empty string `''` is falsy in GitHub Actions expressions. Both branches end up assigning the tiny command.

Use object mapping instead:

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-      docker_cmd: ${{ matrix.spec == 'full' && '' || '--version=1 fuzz-target {TARGET_SOCK}' }}
+      docker_cmd: ${{ fromJSON('{"tiny":"--version=1 fuzz-target {TARGET_SOCK}","full":""}')[matrix.spec] }}
```
</details>

**The GHCR image `ghcr.io/fluffylabs/typeberry:latest` requires authentication and cannot be pulled in CI without credentials.**

Anonymous requests to the manifest endpoint return HTTP 401 with "authentication required". The image is not publicly accessible. The workflow will fail at runtime with an unauthorized error unless authentication credentials are provided in the CI environment.
